summary: Highlands REIT filed an 8-K/A reporting final results of its self-tender offer to buy up to 125,000,000 shares at $0.20 per share in cash. The offer expired September 29, 2026, and was oversubscribed; the company raised the cap using its 2% upsize right and accepted 138,671,199.11759 shares (about 19.2% of shares outstanding at the September 1, 2026 commencement) for roughly $27.73 million. An amendment corrected 3,290,228 additional shares omitted due to third-party administrative errors; payment has occurred. Watch settlement completion and residual float/illiquidity.
